data.purpose: Sheet cells, breakdowns and form fields, tabular figures.

label.purpose: Field labels and figure names, sentence case.

code.purpose: Invoice numbers, SKUs, pasted source text.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Active segment in a segmented control; the login card.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: Side panels over the sheet, with a 32% ink scrim.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, color changes; scrim fade.

motion.name: magic-blur-fade
motion.purpose: Approved Magic UI Blur Fade: import results and drafts list only.

motion.name: magic-number-ticker
motion.value: spring stiffness 170 / damping 26, settles in under 1s (Magic UI default of damping 60 / stiffness 100 took 5-6 s to reach the exact cent)
motion.purpose: Approved Magic UI Number Ticker: figures moving from old to new value on filter change only.

motion.name: magic-highlighter
motion.purpose: Approved Magic UI Text Highlighter: the matched search text in visible rows only.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All motion near-instant; Magic UI effects render their final state.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action on a screen or panel (Download Excel, Save, Sign in).
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"/><path d="m7 10 5 5 5-5"/><path d="M12 15V3"/></svg>Download Excel</button>

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting actions (Import with AI, Check drafts, Review them).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(0.997 0.002 264); color: oklch(0.25 0.03 264); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.25 0.03 264 / 0.18); font: 600 15px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: oklch(0.962 0.007 264); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.45 0.17 263); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.41 0.025 264); font: 600 15px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), color 150ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(0.962 0.007 264); color: oklch(0.25 0.03 264); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.45 0.17 263); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labelled field with a CBT Blue focus ring.

components.html: Website orders checked 2 min ago

components.name: Figures Row
components.description: Five totals between hairlines; Total sales leads in Harbor Navy.
components.css: .ds-figures { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr 1fr; margin: 0; padding: 16px 0; border-top: 1px solid oklch(0.25 0.03 264 / 0.1); border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(0.25 0.03 264 / 0.1); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-figures > div { padding: 0 24px; border-left: 1px solid oklch(0.25 0.03 264 / 0.1); } .ds-figures > .ds-lead { padding-left: 0; border-left: 0; } .ds-figures dt { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: oklch(0.41 0.025 264); } .ds-figures dd { margin: 0; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; color: oklch(0.25 0.03 264); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-figures .ds-lead dd { font-size: 30px; color: oklch(0.32 0.075 248); }

components.name: Needs Your Attention Row
components.description: One row per thing waiting for the owner, with one button.
components.html: 3 sales have details to double-check, like a missing phone or a non-US postal code.
components.css: .ds-attn { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.25 0.03 264 / 0.18); border-radius: 12px; background: oklch(0.997 0.002 264); color: oklch(0.41 0.025 264); font: 400 15px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-attn strong { color: oklch(0.25 0.03 264); font-weight: 600; } .ds-attn button { min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(0.997 0.002 264); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.25 0.03 264 / 0.18); font: 600 15px inherit; color: oklch(0.25 0.03 264); cursor: pointer; } .ds-attn button:hover { background: oklch(0.962 0.007 264); }

narrative.overview:
This is the ledger kept in the back room of a wholesale supply company: exact figures in tidy columns, written in the company's own blue ink, on paper that never competes with the numbers. The owner sits down at a desk at the start or end of the day, reads what sold, settles anything that needs them, and closes the book. Every visual decision serves that ten-minute routine. The interface is calm until something needs a decision, then says so plainly.

The system is restrained by doctrine. Paper and ink carry almost every screen; CBT blue appears only where the owner acts or has selected something; amber, coral and the logo's canopy green are reserved for states (to check, a problem, all good). Density is a working ledger's density: sixteen columns are fine, small type is not. Motion is limited to state changes and the three approved Magic UI effects, each of which must stand down for people who turn motion off.
keyCharacteristics: Paper-and-ink neutrals tinted toward CBT blue (hue 264); never pure white or black.
One action color: CBT blue, matched to the website's #1346AF.
Numbers in tabular figures, right-aligned, never rounded, never hidden.
Hairline rules instead of boxes; cards only where a group must read as one unit.
16px base text, 15px in the sheet, 40px controls: easy to read in bright stockroom light.
Motion conveys state; the three approved Magic UI effects are the only flourishes.

rules.name: The Blue Ink Rule
rules.body: CBT Blue marks what the owner can act on or has selected, and nothing else. If a screen shows CBT Blue on more than one primary button, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Amber Is Not Red Rule
rules.body: Drafts and review flags are amber, never coral. Coral means something failed or will be destroyed. A held AI draft is the system being careful, not the owner making a mistake.

rules.name: The 4.5 Floor Rule
rules.body: No text below 4.5:1 contrast. Ledger Ink Faint is the floor; anything lighter is decoration and must not carry words.

rules.name: The No Tiny Capitals Rule
rules.body: Labels are sentence case at 13px or larger. Letter-spaced all-caps micro labels are prohibited: they are the hardest text to read and the most AI-generated-looking.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every money and count value uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums and is right-aligned in columns, so cents line up down the page like a ledger.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Group with a 1px rule or spacing before reaching for a box, and a box before a shadow. Nested boxes are prohibited.

dos: Do keep CBT Blue (oklch(0.45 0.17 263)) to primary buttons, focus, selection and breakdown bars: one primary button per screen or panel.
Do use the shadcn/ui primitive named in Components for any new control, restyled with these tokens, before writing a custom one.
Do show every amount exactly, with cents, in tabular figures, right-aligned.
Do say where each sale came from: the AI badge in the sheet, the Source column in the Excel download, the source line on drafts.
Do put anything that needs the owner into the "Needs your attention" list as one row with one button, and remove the row when it's resolved.
Do wrap every Magic UI effect so it renders the final state under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce; none of the three approved components does this on its own.
Do keep text at 13px or larger and at 4.5:1 contrast or better (Ledger Ink Faint is the floor).
Do give icon-only buttons an aria-label and pair every color meaning with an icon or words.
donts: Don't build "Generic AI-generated SaaS dashboards: purple gradients, glass cards, giant hero metrics with sparkline confetti." No figures in colored cards, no gradient text, no backdrop blur.

Don't imitate "Busy 'growth' analytics tools that shout with color and motion." The approved Magic UI list is Number Ticker, Blur Fade and Text Highlighter; Border Beam, Shine Border, Magic Card, Neon Gradient Card, Meteors, Confetti, Particles, patterns, aurora or animated-gradient text, and every shimmer, rainbow, ripple or pulsating button are prohibited.
Don't assume "keyboard shortcuts and technical vocabulary": every action has a visible, labeled control and plain words.
Don't make "a draft or warning look like an error the owner caused." Drafts and review flags are amber; coral is only for failures and destroying data.
Don't animate on page load, and don't count figures up from zero.
Don't use letter-spaced all-caps micro labels, side-stripe borders thicker than 1px, or nested boxes.
Don't add a dark theme: the owner works at a desk in office light.
Don't use em dashes in interface copy; use a middle dot, colon or period.
